title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten distinct, named destinations in Eddy Street Commons, the North Eddy Street commercial corridor beside Notre Dame and within Saint Mary’s practical orbit.

cards.title: 7 Eleven for a 24-hour stop
cards.subtitle: Eddy Street Commons on North Eddy Street
cards.notes: Use this North Eddy Street stop when you need a convenience-store errand at an unusual hour; the center lists this location as open 24 hours.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience-store option on the Eddy Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Eddy Street Commons lists 7 Eleven in its directory and states that it is open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: The official center listing says “Open 24 Hours.”
